cards.title: Billing periods
intro: They divide the category of programmes into coherent periods, for example, semesters. This will allow you to efficiently work with classes and bookings within a given period - Spring 2023 or Autumn 2023.
These dates are optional. They're only used to pre-fill the date range when you create a class for this period with simple scheduling — leave them empty if you don't use it.

fields.label: Active billing period
fields.help: Mark the option to set the billing period as active. The period marked in this way will be displayed within the application.
